subject: Catalina on-site week clash — propose split (recording + short live sync)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@catalinahealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo for Catalina — travel update

Hi Mina / Rachel,

Quick update from our side — the leadership team shifted our on-site week one week earlier than planned and several stakeholders who were slated to join the demo are now traveling on the new dates. I attached the updated itinerary. Super sorry for the late notice.

We still very much want to see Redwood in action — two options from our side: (A) keep the scheduled demo but reduce it to 30 minutes focused on high-level value + Q&A (we'll have only the two PMs available live), or (B) record a fuller walkthrough for the cross-functional group and follow up with a short live sync when more people are back.

Which approach would you recommend? We can do a brief live slot on Oct 21 at 11:00 PT if that helps.

Thanks,
Liam

Subject: Re: Quick demo for Catalina — travel update

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the itinerary. Totally understand the scheduling squeeze.

Given the stakeholder availability, I propose a split plan so we don't lose momentum:
- We will record a full 25–30 minute walkthrough (screen + narration) covering the use cases we discussed (live inference routing, cost/latency dashboards, and rollout controls). We'll share the recording and the short deck by EOD Oct 15.
- Schedule a 25–30 minute live sync the week after your on-site (you suggested Oct 21) for the broader group to ask questions and see any targeted follow-ups. If 11:00 PT on Oct 21 works for you, we'll reserve that.

Vivek — can you own the recording? Olga — can you prep 3 quick slides on onboarding and success metrics to drop in the recording? Rachel — I'll send an updated mutual action plan and confirm recording logistics.

We can also do option A (condensed live demo) if you prefer a quick live hit — but the recording + short sync tends to get better alignment across functions.

Cheers,
Mina

Attachment: redwood-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

Copy — happy to own the recording. Plan: 28-minute walk-through + 2–3 minute snappy intro. Outline: 1) short value recap (2m), 2) routing and fallbacks demo (10m), 3) dashboard tour, cost/latency breakdown (8m), 4) rollout + canary/A-B (6m), 5) quick Qs baked as notes.

Liam — do you want the recording to include a short, anonymized example of your likely traffic profile (we can mock it from the use case you shared)? If yes, send any preferences or red lines. Otherwise we'll use a standard demo dataset.

I can record Thursday morning and hand off the file to Mina by EOD.

— Vivek
